Nietzschesource

Nietzschesource describes itself as a ‘web site devoted to the publication of scholarly content on the work and life of Friedrich Nietzsche’. So far, two editions of Nietzsche’s work have been made available on Nietzschesource: the Digitale Kritische Gesamtausgabe Werke und Briefe (eKGWB) and the Digitale Faksimile Gesamtausgabe (DFGA) of theNietzsche Estate.

To be sure, Nietzschesource is certainly a very good starting-point for the study of the works of Nietzsche.

References

  1. Sahle, Patrick. Digitale Editionsformen. 3 vols. Norderstedt: BoD, 2013.
  2. Schaberg, William. The Nietzsche Canon: A Publication History and Bibliography. Chicago: University of Chicago Press, 1995.
